system.description: Whenever you use the Search Your Feelings application of the Use the Force skill, you can sense the consequences of your actions out to 1 hour into the future (instead of the normal 10 minutes). You can spend a Force Point when you do so to expand this window out to 8 hours, or a Destiny Point to expand this window out to 24 hours.

prerequisite.text: a member of The Baran Do Sages
